ocean12.label: OCEAN QUIZ
ocean12.intro: Ocean quiz! Twelve questions about the sea. Keep score, and see how many you get!

items.q: Which sea creature can reverse its age?
items.say: The jellyfish! One tiny kind can turn itself young again.

items.q: How long can a Greenland shark live?
items.say: About four hundred years! No other animal with a backbone is known to live longer.

items.q: What is a group of fish called?
items.say: A school!

items.q: What is the deepest point in the ocean?
items.say: The Mariana Trench! Almost eleven kilometers deep.

items.q: What is the largest coral reef in the world?
items.f: You can see it from space!
items.say: The Great Barrier Reef! You can even see it from space.

items.q: What do blue whales mostly eat?
items.say: Krill! Tiny shrimp-like animals. They eat tonnes of it every day.

items.q: How many limbs does a squid have?
items.say: Ten! Eight arms, plus two long tentacles.

items.q: Which fish can puff up like a balloon?
items.f: Most are very poisonous to eat!
items.say: The pufferfish! And most are very poisonous to eat.

items.q: In seahorses, which parent carries the babies?
items.say: The father! Seahorse dads give birth.

items.q: What is the largest sea turtle?
items.say: The leatherback! Some weigh more than six hundred kilograms.

items.q: How much of Earth is covered by ocean?
items.f: And most of it is unexplored!
items.say: About seventy percent! And most of it is still unexplored.

items.q: How do most starfish eat?
items.f: It digests food outside its body!
items.say: It pushes its stomach out of its body, and digests its food outside!

space12.label: SPACE QUIZ
space12.intro: Space quiz! Twelve questions about planets and stars. Keep score, and see how many you get!

items.q: How many planets are in our solar system?
items.f: Pluto became a dwarf planet in 2006!
items.say: Eight! Pluto became a dwarf planet in two thousand six.

items.q: What is the closest star to Earth?
items.say: The Sun! It's a star too.

items.q: Which planet has the most known moons?
items.say: Saturn! More than two hundred seventy moons.

items.q: Which planet is the hottest?
items.say: Venus! Its thick clouds trap the heat.

items.q: Which planet is called the Red Planet?
items.f: Its dust is full of rust!
items.say: Mars! Its dust is full of rust.

items.q: Which planet spins on its side?
items.say: Uranus! It's tilted almost ninety eight degrees.

items.q: What is a shooting star really?
items.say: A space rock, burning up in our air!

items.q: What is the Milky Way?
items.say: A galaxy! Our home galaxy.

items.q: Who first walked on the Moon?
items.say: Neil Armstrong, in nineteen sixty nine!

items.q: Which planet has the Great Red Spot?
items.say: Jupiter! It's a storm bigger than Earth.

items.q: Which planet is farthest from the Sun?
items.say: Neptune! One year there lasts a hundred sixty five Earth years.

items.q: What is the Sun mostly made of?
items.say: Hydrogen! It's not fire at all.

body12.label: HUMAN BODY QUIZ
body12.intro: Human body quiz! Twelve questions about you. Keep score, and see how many you get!

items.q: What is the largest organ of your body?
items.f: Up to 2 square meters of it!
items.say: Your skin! Up to two square meters of it.

items.q: Where is the smallest bone in your body?
items.f: Smaller than a grain of rice!
items.say: In your ear! It's smaller than a grain of rice.

items.q: How many teeth in a full adult set?
items.say: Thirty two, including four wisdom teeth.

items.q: How many chambers does your heart have?
items.say: Four! Two on each side.

items.q: Where is your longest bone?
items.say: In your leg! The thigh bone, called the femur.

items.q: What color is the blood inside your veins?
items.say: Red! It's never blue, just a darker red.

items.q: What do your kidneys do?
items.say: They filter your blood. About a hundred fifty liters a day!

items.q: Which lung is smaller?
items.f: It makes room for your heart!
items.say: The left one! It makes room for your heart.

items.q: Which part of your eye controls how much light gets in?
items.say: The iris! The colored part. The pupil is just the opening.

items.q: Which vitamin does your skin make from sunlight?
items.say: Vitamin D! It helps keep your bones strong.

items.q: Which blood type can be given to almost anyone?
items.say: O negative! The universal donor.

items.q: Which organ can grow back after part is removed?
items.f: It can regrow to full size!
items.say: The liver! It can grow back to full size.
